item_name: Officially Licensed NYPD Adjustable Cap With Emblem
item_short_desc: Support New York’s Finest with this Officially Licensed NYPD Adjustable Cap With Emblem.
description: Support New York’s Finest with this Officially Licensed NYPD Adjustable Cap With Emblem. “NYPD” name with centered NYPD emblem is embroidered on the NYPD cap’s front panel in gold and blue thread. The iconic saying, “NEW YORK’S FINEST” is embroidered on the back panel of this N.Y.P.D. cap in stark gold thread. This New York City Police Department hat features an adjustable hook and loop closure for a custom, snug fit. The NYPD emblem hat is constructed with 100% cotton for a comfortable and breathable all day wear and is officially licensed by the City of New York.
